overview: Monsters University is a 2013 American animated comedy film directed by Dan Scanlon and written by Scanlon and the writing team of Dan Gerson and Robert L. Baird. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, it is a prequel to Monsters, Inc. (2001). Randy Newman composed the original score, returning from the first film. The film follows the main characters of Monsters, Inc., James P. "Sulley" Sullivan and Mike Wazowski, and their experience in college leading to them becoming best friends. Billy Crystal, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi, Bob Peterson and John Ratzenberger reprise their roles from the first film, while Bonnie Hunt voices a different character. Helen Mirren, Peter Sohn, Joel Murray, Sean Hayes, Dave Foley, Charlie Day and Nathan Fillion join the voice cast.
